About Ko Kaeo

Ko Kaeo is on the eastern side of Mueang Phuket district, away from the west-coast beaches. Project descriptions point to the Boat Lagoon marina area, schools such as the British International School and Finnway, and hospitals as the main nearby destinations; one villa development states that it is not within walking distance of a beach.

Our three projects here are villas and townhouses, with a mix of off-plan and completed developments.

Why buyers choose Ko Kaeo

  • Boat Lagoon and Royal Phuket Marina
  • Large housing and villa estates
  • Close to Phuket Town and Central Phuket
  • Residential, non-touristy setting

Lifestyle and amenities

Ko Kaeo is practical and residential, with supermarkets, international schools, marinas and easy access to Phuket Town's hospitals and shopping.

Beaches and surroundings

Ko Kaeo is on the east coast, which has mangroves and marinas rather than swimming beaches. The west-coast beaches are about 20 to 30 minutes away by car.

Rental demand in Ko Kaeo

Ko Kaeo is a long-term rental market. Tenants are mainly families with children at nearby schools, boat owners and professionals working in Phuket Town.

Long-term rentals

Families and professionals look for houses and villas with gardens close to schools.

Short-term holiday rentals

Limited, because there is no beach nearby.

Suitable property types

Family houses, townhouses and villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: steady residential demand. Limitations: little holiday demand and far from the west-coast beaches.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Ko Kaeo

Ko Kaeo suits buyers who want a family home or a long-term rental near schools, marinas and Phuket Town rather than a holiday property.

Typical investor profiles

Families and long-term rental investors.

Risks to consider

Lower rental prices than tourist areas; many housing estates compete.

Ownership costs

Maintenance, estate fees, insurance and periods between tenants.

Ko Kaeo: frequently asked questions

Where is Ko Kaeo in Phuket?

Ko Kaeo is a subdistrict on the east side of the island, north of Phuket Town and south of Thalang.

Are there beaches in Ko Kaeo?

No swimming beaches; the east coast here has mangroves and marinas. The west-coast beaches are about 20 to 30 minutes away.

Is Ko Kaeo good for families?

Yes, many families live here because of the international schools, supermarkets and housing estates.

Which marinas are in Ko Kaeo?

Boat Lagoon and Royal Phuket Marina are both in Ko Kaeo.

How far is Ko Kaeo from the airport?

Our project data gives about 22 to 25 km to Phuket International Airport.

How much does property in Ko Kaeo cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Ko Kaeo run from ฿4,900,000 to ฿19,900,000 (3 of 3 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
